INSERT INTO whatsapp_outgoing_event (account_id, chat_jid, message_id, nonce, value)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (account_id, chat_jid, message_id) DO UPDATE SET
                created_at = now(),
                nonce = EXCLUDED.nonce,
                value = EXCLUDED.value
